text:
alex: Quick idea — operator-facing compact 'why fallback' view in the Console. Short, one-line card with expand for details. feedback?

mira: Love it. Minimal info: trigger, error_code, chosen_model, trace id. keep it terse.

sam: +1. Also we need a sampling pct and link to relevant playbook so ops can triage. don't overload the card.

tasha: UX question — do we show classifier/confidence numbers? might be noisy or leak model internals. maybe just a label and details link.

kiana: We should always surface an audit link to full logs: example -> https://console.redwood.internal/traces/trace-176777-99

alex: Prototype payload we could surface in the popover: 

```json
{"fallback_id":"fb-2024-06-01-99","trigger":"latency_spike","error_code":"503_ai_timeout","chosen":"gptq-7b-q4","trace":"trace-176777-99"}
```

mira: Where does sampling decision live? router or SDK? need clarity for endpoint correlation.

sam: Server/router layer. SDK sees final decision only. I propose adding `X-Fallback-Trace` header to responses so users can correlate traces.

 tasha: Headers ok but must be opaque — no PII. `trace-xxxx` style IDs only. Also opt-out option for customers.

ops: We also need to persist `why_did_you_fallback` events in audit store with retention defaulting to 90d and configurable per-tenant.

kiana: Also need to denote mode: soft_degrade vs hard_switchover. Suggest `mode: soft_degrade|hard_switchover` in payload.

alex: UX flow idea: single-line card in route's Rollout timeline. Hover expands popover with the JSON block, link to playback, and quick actions (mark incident, pause canary).

mira: :thumbsup: Should we allow 'revert rollout' from this card? risky.

sam: Limit operator actions. 'Revert rollout' requires multi-step auth + audit entry. Card can have 'mark incident' and 'pause canary' only.

alex: Also include an operator-friendly short explanation string, e.g. `Short explanation: 'Fallback due to 95th p90 latency > 1200ms for route /chat'`. That helps non-dev responders.

tasha: Edge case: model_error_classification fallbacks — showing classifier score might cause confusion. Maybe show discretized buckets (high/medium/low) and full score in audit log.

kiana: Good call. UI shows reason bucket (latency/model_err/quota/capacity) + 'details' link for full JSON.

deploy-bot: policy-deploy: automatic-fallback-v2 rolled to staging @eng-platform — run `/playback trace-176777-99` to inspect.

alex: Next steps: mockup by @mira, API contract draft by @sam (include `X-Fallback-Trace` and `X-Fallback-Reason` headers), and retention + replay spec by @ops. I'll schedule a 30m sync.

mira: I'll drop a Figma mock this afternoon and annotate copy. cc @tasha for messaging.

ops: I'll draft retention + audit replay doc and share EOD.

alex: Thanks all — small, compact card but full drilldown for audits is the goal.
